title: Ash Cleanup
summary: The Dragon Tower's spawners still pour out Ashlord's skeleton guards, and they wander down to burn the farms. Go back to the tower and thin them out.

dialogue.intro: Burning crops. Burning goats. They come from the tower, the cages inside it keep making more.
